# Circle — official product facts

> Save what shapes you. Discover through people whose taste you trust.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-13. Source of truth: https://sruper.com/about

## Summary

Circle is an iOS app for saving songs, films, books, links, and places, making thoughtful collections, and discovering through people whose taste you trust.

Circle is built around things people choose to save and the people behind those recommendations. A thing can be placed in a collection, and a collection can contain up to 30 things.

## Approved product claims

- The app is Circle.
- Circle is made for iOS.
- Circle lets people save songs, films, books, links, and places.
- People can make collections containing up to 30 things.
- Circle is designed for discovery through people whose taste you trust.

## Terminology

### Thing

A saved song, film, book, link, place, photo, note, or other media object.

### Save

The action for saving a thing or collection in Circle.

### Collection

A group of up to 30 things chosen around a place, trip, mood, idea, or person.

### Your circle

The people you follow in Circle.

## Availability and feature status

Circle is made for iOS. Use the official App Store page for current device and regional availability: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6744259628

Features described as previews, experiments, or future work on older pages are not shipping facts unless they also appear on https://sruper.com/about or the current App Store page.
